landing_intro: Radical Feedback helps your team assess together how much each person contributed to the result. Everyone distributes 100 % across all members, including themselves. Your ratings stay anonymous: nobody sees who gave how much to whom. Your self-assessments are only shown if everyone agrees.
landing_how: How it works: first, everyone briefly describes what their work consisted of during this period and confirms with “I’m ready”. Then you all rate, see an interim result and talk about it. Then you rate a second time, and that result counts.
landing_honest: Important: be honest, including with yourselves. Anyone who clearly over- or underestimates themselves gets a deduction. This is not about rating people, but about their contribution to this work.
create_hint: One name per line, 3 to 9 names. If you take part yourself, add your own name too.
created_hint: Send this link to all participants. You join via this link as well.
confirm_reset: “{name}” is already taken. Is that you? Then the name moves to this phone and everything from the other phone is discarded.
lobby_text: Before you start, everyone briefly describes what their work in the project consisted of during the period in question. Then everyone presses “I’m ready” – ready to use the tool and to speak openly and constructively.
show_label: My self-assessment may be shown to everyone (this only happens if everyone agrees).
lobby_waiting: Round 1 starts when everyone is ready.
round2_hint: This round is final and determines the distribution. You may change your values from round 1. The further your self-assessment is from the others’ view, the larger the deduction. Overestimating yourself costs twice as much as underestimating.
rate_hint: Distribute 100 % across everyone, including yourself. Whole numbers only.
warn_zero: Are you sure {name} contributed nothing at all?
warn_hundred: Are you sure {name} did all the work?
warn_equal: Are you sure everyone really contributed equally?
submitted: Your rating has been submitted. You can change it until everyone has submitted.
discuss_intro: Look at the interim result. Now it’s time for an open conversation. A few rules:
rule_1: Talk about the work, not the person.
rule_2: Give concrete examples instead of general judgements.
rule_4: Listen without defending yourself right away.
rule_5: Ask if a rating surprises you.
discuss_invisible: Make invisible work visible: people usually see their own work and that of their closest colleagues better than everyone else’s. If your work was hardly visible to others, briefly explain what you did.
discuss_flow: Suggested flow: everyone briefly says what surprised them about the interim result. Then you can talk freely.
ready2_waiting: Round 2 starts when everyone is ready.
final_text: Congratulations, you gave each other open feedback – that’s not something to take for granted. Here is your final distribution of contributions. What you distribute with it is up to you.
tb_accuracy_noticeable: There are noticeable differences between self-assessment and others’ view.
tb_accuracy_strong: There are strong differences between self-assessment and others’ view.
tb_direction_realistic: On average, you assess yourselves realistically.
tb_convergence_closer: After the conversation, your self-assessments are closer to the others’ view.
tb_convergence_apart: After the conversation, your self-assessments are further from the others’ view.
tb_convergence_same: The gap between self-assessment and others’ view has hardly changed.
delete_hint: All data is deleted automatically after 30 days. From one day after the final result, any participant can delete the session earlier.
confirm_delete: Delete the session permanently? This cannot be undone.
feedback_title: How was the session for you?
done_text: The session is finished for you. You can still save your result.
own_row_hint: Your own row shows your self-assessment and the average of the others’ ratings.
you_removed: You no longer take part in the rating.
err_calc: Calculation error, please create a new session.
err_network: No connection to the server. Please try again.
err_duplicate_name: Each name may only appear once.
err_name_too_long: One of the names is too long (max. 30 characters).
err_removed: This person no longer takes part in the rating.
err_phase: This isn’t possible at this step.
err_too_early: Deleting is only possible one day after the final result.
err_not_auth: Your phone is no longer signed in for this name.
err_busy: The server is busy right now. Please try again.
err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err_feedback_empty: Please give stars or write a text.
